description: Fetch a page and scan all visible text for em dashes (U+2014), en dashes (U+2013), and a configurable list of banned words. Returns every occurrence with surrounding context.

banned_words.description: Optional list of banned words. Defaults to: delve, tapestry, landscape, robust, leverage, harness, empower, revolutionize, seamlessly, utilize, facilitate, synergy.

url.description: The full URL to audit (e.g. https://example.com)

name: qc_copy_audit
